title: Pump Control in MDI bug upload data Treatment in Nightscout - openaps://AndroidAPS
symptom: Using the Pump Control 3.0.0.1 version, in MDI, AndroidAPS creates a new Treatment input for each received reading (from xdrip) with the description openaps://AndroidAPS + Profile Name in cell phone. The information appears in Nightscout and also in the AndroidAPS Overview graph.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced in the thread.
